name: @aimless/workspace
description: A highly scalable and multifunctional browser extension.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc -p monkey-scripts/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter ./packages/shared exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter ./packages/ui exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter ./apps/toolbox exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter ./extensions/aimless compile
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.build: pnpm build:site && pnpm build:extension && pnpm verify:extension
